arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. Because you've noticed a gassy smell, please treat it as a safety issue, even if it's only now and then. Please don't use the oven or hob, and don't use any switches, flames or sparks near it. If you smell gas now, leave the flat, leave the door open behind you, and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours). Call 999 if anyone is in immediate danger. We're passing this to our team now as an emergency and will arrange for a qualified engineer to check the oven and the gas supply; our target is within 24 hours. We'll be in touch with the details.

Please don't use the oven or hob, and don't use any switches, flames or sparks near it. We're passing this to our team now as an emergency and will arrange for a qualified engineer to check the oven and the gas supply; our target is within 24 hours. We'll be in touch with the details.
